title: UUID Generator
seoTitle: Free UUID Generator — Generate UUIDs Online
description: Generate random UUIDs (v4) instantly in your browser. Copy one or many. No server, completely private.
intro: Click to generate a new UUID v4. Optionally generate several at once and copy them.
blurb: Generate cryptographically random UUID version 4 identifiers.
howItWorks: Set how many UUIDs you need (1–50).
Click Generate. Each is a random version 4 UUID.
Copy the results for use in code, databases, or testing.
examples: Generate a single ID for a new database record.
Create 10 UUIDs for a test data set.
Use in APIs, filenames, or session identifiers.

faq.q: Is this a real UUID v4?
faq.a: Yes. It uses crypto.getRandomValues for strong randomness, matching the UUID version 4 specification.
The chance of collision is astronomically low for practical use.

faq.q: Does it require an internet connection after loading?
faq.a: No. Generation happens entirely in your browser.
